messages:
Priya (SE): FYI AcmeHealth POC hitting a streaming hang behind their corp proxy. TS SDK streaming starts then stalls after ~10s, no data for minutes. Anyone seen this with inspected TLS?
Tom (Solutions): Oof. Are you getting any errors in the client or server logs? trace id?
Priya (SE): Client shows no exception, stream never ends. Server logs show intermittent 503 + 'upstream write failed' and x-rate-limit-remaining: 0 on some requests. trace=tr-9f4a2c7b
Asha (Eng): Can you paste the minimal TS snippet you're using? Also which SDK version and Node version?
Priya (SE): Using our async streaming helper:
```ts
const s = client.responses.stream({model: 'redwood-16k', input: prompt});
s.on('data', (c) => console.log('chunk', c.text));
```
Node 18, @redwood/js 0.9.2
Diego (Eng-runtime): That SDK version had a fix for header propagation in 0.9.4 — but hangs behind middleboxes are usually proxy keepalive or TLS inspection. Do you have packet logs or proxy config from Acme?
Laura (AE): Acme security team is on the call but slow — they're running a corporate TLS inspection appliance that requires mutual TLS re-signing. They said streaming worked with other vendors earlier though.
Tom (Solutions): Two things to triage quickly: 1) confirm connection keepalive/ping from client to prevent proxy idle close, 2) check for payload-level backpressure where inspector buffers until chunk threshold.
Priya (SE): I grabbed the runtime logs from our side:
[2026-02-12T14:12:05Z] ERROR inference-gw: upstream write failed status=503 trace=tr-9f4a2c7b headers={"x-rate-limit-remaining":"0","connection":"keep-alive"}
[2026-02-12T14:12:06Z] WARN stream: client reset by peer
Asha (Eng): x-rate-limit-remaining=0 explains 429s but not steady stalls. If the inspector re-signs and buffers TLS, it can hold the socket open and buffer small chunks until full, creating the appearance of a hang.
Diego (Eng-runtime): Can you try toggling chunking to larger chunks and enable periodic keepalive bytes? In TS SDK set chunkSize or send a heartbeat: `s.send({type:'ping'})` every 5s as experiment.
Priya (SE): Trying now. Also asked Acme FW team to check 'inspect buffer size' and 'max idle reassembly'
Laura (AE): Parallel ask: Acme asked about Dedicated capacity pricing for this POC to avoid corporate inspection. I flagged pricing sheet — they want monthly commit quote for 4 v100 equiv nodes. Who owns that? @Tom
Tom (Solutions): I'll draft the dedicated quote. Meanwhile we should validate POC works on Dedicated without middlebox. If so, propose Dedicated + VPC as mitigation for security and latency.
Asha (Eng): For immediate triage: add `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-http-header-size=16384` on the client and set SDK keepalive to 20s. Also upgrade SDK to 0.9.5 with header propagation fix.
Priya (SE): After increasing chunk size + heartbeat I see steady chunks again for 2m, then a gap but no full failure. Sending logs to Diego.
Diego (Eng-runtime): Got logs. Looks like inspector closed idle upstreams and re-handshake created a short buffer spike. I'll open a runtime ticket to add an adaptive keepalive recommendation for streaming docs and add a flag to force periodic NOP frames from the runtime.
Priya (SE): Also running their security questionnaire — they asked about client cert handling and HSM. I replied with our KMS/HSM statement and invited security@redwood for the call. FYI Laura
Laura (AE): Perfect. I'll attach the Dedicated quote + SSO/SCIM options. If Acme signs a commit, we can prioritize a routing policy to keep them on dedicated nodes to avoid corporate inspectors.
Tom (Solutions): Next steps: (1) Priya validate with upgraded SDK and keepalive turned on, (2) Acme FW to confirm inspect buffer settings, (3) Diego open runtime ticket for heartbeat option, (4) Laura send Dedicated quote. Reopen here with new logs.
Priya (SE): Doing step 1 now, will post results in 15m :thumbsup:
eng-runtime-bot: Ticket RT-3721 created by Diego: "add streaming heartbeat config + docs" assigned to eng-runtime. ETA 5d.
Priya (SE): Update — after upgrade to 0.9.5 + keepalive 20s, streaming stable for 30m. Sending final test recordings. Marking this as resolved for now, will reopen if it recurs.
Tom (Solutions): Great outcome — I'll follow up with price + contract guidance for Dedicated.
Diego (Eng-runtime): I'll keep RT-3721 active and add a small PR with recommended default keepalive in the SDK.
Priya (SE): Thanks everyone!"
